author: 0daywatch
text:
ZDW BRIEF

Drupal's security team says Commerce Core CVE-2026-118539 is being actively exploited. Weak checks on some routes and fields allow an access bypass that may financially affect a store.

Upgrade to 3.3.13 or 8.x-2.41 and audit orders for anything unexpected.

author: YouParcel
text: PHP2Shell: two critical flaws in the PHP runtime (CVE-2026-109618 and CVE-2026-109619), disclosed in October 2026. An unauthenticated attacker can run code on your server with a crafted web request. No login needed.

author: SecAlertsCo
text: Public PoC dropped for CVE-2026-120345: WAVLINK WN551X3-A router OS command injection via sub_41a430 in the DNS Resolution Handler (/bin/ioos). No auth needed, full system impact.

author: AlmaLinux
text: A new Linux kernel vulnerability (CVE-2026-98276) is a race condition in the socket code that can lead to a use-after-free of a UDP socket. AlmaLinux 8, 9, and 10 are affected. Patched kernels are available in the testing repository.

author: realNickPawlak
text: A research AI model whose browser could not reach a page spent hours finding another way out of its sandbox, restarting the browser and scanning the private network.

author: DecryptionDigst
text:
SonicWall SSLVPN is being actively exploited. CVE-2026-19868 bypasses both SAML and MFA on Gen7/Gen8 firewalls. CISA added to KEV Nov 6. Federal patch deadline: Nov 20. No workarounds. Patch now.

https://t.co/3hu6pMJniS

text:

author: teamnebulaai
text: 81 unknown high-severity Firefox flaws surfaced in OpenAI's GPT-6 Cyber testing, after extensive prior testing with frontier models. It built 948 Linux privilege-escalation exploits. On a remote exploit benchmark, GPT-6 Astra refused every task; GPT-6 Cyber completed 95 percent.

text:

author: TheHackerWire
text: Unauthenticated OS RCE in AWS Aurora PostgreSQL and Babelfish (CVE-2026-119923, CVSS 9.8). A heap buffer overflow in the TDS prelogin parser (port 1433) lets remote attackers execute OS commands. Apply AWS Bulletin 2026-166.

author: Telestijl
text: CVE-2026-116635 (published 2 Nov): aws-serverless-mcp-server before 0.2.1, path traversal via the project name in the deployment status component. Update to 0.2.1, and keep write mode off unless you need it.

author: ICHI_Global
text: Craft CMS (< 5.11.2): CVE-2026-124427 (CVSS 9.8) auth bypass lets anonymous GraphQL clients read restricted entries; CVE-2026-124430 (CVSS 8.8) RCE for non-admin CP users via a template signing oracle. Patch to 5.11.2.

author: jenistranger
text: UnrealIRCd says an AI-assisted audit found its worst bug in 15 years. CVE-2026-114713 lets a regular user act with server/IRCOp privileges on linked networks. No public PoC yet. Patch to 6.2.7.1, or apply the hot-patch with no restart.

author: ICHI_Global
text: CVE-2026-124440 (CVSS 9.9) in Kyverno: namespace tenants can escalate to cluster admin via malformed apiCall URL escapes. Upgrade to 1.19.2.

author: TraffAlex
